newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: GLOBE AWARDS $5.2 MLN CONTRACT TO ERICSSON.
newsitem.headline: GLOBE AWARDS $5.2 MLN CONTRACT TO ERICSSON.

text.p: Ericsson Telecommunications Inc said on Thursday it has signed an agreement with the Philippine's Globe Telecom for the installation of 6,200 telephone lines worth $5.2 million.
In a statement, Ericsson said the lines will be installed in the southern island of Mindanao as well as the provinces of Cavite and Mindoro in the northern island of Luzon.
Ericsson said it will use its radio access system that reduces substantially the installation period per line.
Ericsson also offered to install 50,000 more lines within Globe's service area.
Globe Telecom, a joint venture of Ayala Corp and Singapore Telecommunications Ltd, is mandated to install 700,000 fixed telephone lines.
Ericsson Telecommunications is a unit of Ericsson SPA.
